queue.claim: Since UE 5.6 (2025), MetaHumans fall under the Unreal Engine EULA and may be used outside Unreal (Blender, Maya, Unity, Godot) and sold on Fab. Royalty and seat terms outside UE are unknown. There is no first-party single-photo to MetaHuman path; identity needs a mesh or depth/stereo footage.

queue.claim: KeenTools FaceBuilder for Blender is a GPL Python add-on that downloads a proprietary core. It is paid by subscription with a trial (roughly US$100–300 per seat-year). It exports 51 ARKit-compatible blendshapes and imports Live Link Face CSV. Blender 5.x support is unknown.

queue.claim: No independent, peer-reviewed mm-level accuracy benchmark exists for commercial photo-to-head tools (FaceBuilder, Headshot, Mesh to MetaHuman, avatar SDKs) against ground-truth scans. The accuracy-ladder estimates (single photo 1.2–3 mm, multi-view pin fit 0.8–2 mm) are unbenchmarked.
